basic_details.job_title: NBRC Project Associate-I (Project) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The National Brain Research Centre (NBRC), Manesar, Gurugram, Haryana, has invited applications for one Project Associate-I (Project) post in the HFSP funded project "Molecular memories in single cells: An integrated approach to how cells learn". The fellowship is ₹ 31,000 + HRA per month for candidates who have qualified a national level examination, or ₹ 25,000 + HRA per month for others. The tenure is one year, renewable for one more year on successful performance review. how_to_apply: Applications are made in hard copy, in the format attached to the notice, along with a CV and self-attested copies of certificates in support of qualifications and experience.
Fill in the application form of Advertisement No. Acad./17/2026, with items 1 to 4 in capital letters.
Attach a detailed curriculum vitae and self-attested copies of certificates of educational qualification and experience.
Attach the category certificate if you are an SC / ST / Physically challenged candidate.
Attach a recent, signed passport size photograph.

Pay the ₹ 200 application fee by Demand Draft in favor of 'Director, NBRC, Manesar', or online / via UPI to the 'National Brain Research Centre' account (Account No. 915010023259375, IFSC Code UTIB0000720, Branch: IMT Manesar).
Write "Application for Project Associate-I (Project)" on the envelope.
Send it to: The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, NH-8, Manesar-122052, Distt Gurugram, Haryana. The hard copy should reach the office by 08.12.2026.

The first page of the notice gives the address as "Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, Nainwal Mode, Gurugram-122 052 (Haryana)". The application form is headed with the email ID [email protected]; the notice does not say that applications are to be sent by email.
important_instructions: No TA/DA is payable to candidates for attending the interview. Applications without self-attested copies of certificates of qualification and experience stand summarily rejected without any intimation. An incomplete application is summarily rejected without giving any reason. If any information is found incorrect or misleading, the candidature is liable to cancellation by NBRC at any time. The application form carries a declaration, with place, date and the candidate's signature.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of this single post.

rows.pay: ₹ 31,000 + HRA pm or ₹ 25,000 + HRA pm, depending on the pay rule below

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a Master's degree in Natural Sciences or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine, from a recognized University or equivalent, with minimum 60% marks. Age limit: maximum 35 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: Masters' degree in Natural Sciences or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc, or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine, from a recognized University or equivalent with minimum 60% marks
rows.desirable: Experience in animal behavior or microscopy or electrophysiology or computation biology or primary neuronal culture

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: No other allowances are applicable. The tenure is one year and renewable for one more year upon successful review of performance. The post is co-terminus with the project. Accommodation may be provided as per rules of NBRC, subject to availability. The job contract is regulated by the terms of the project and the prevailing rules and procedure followed at NBRC from time to time.

(ii) Candidates who do not fall under (i)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBRC Project Associate-I (Project)
content_sections.text: Applications are made in hard copy, in the format attached to the notice, along with a CV and self-attested copies of certificates in support of qualifications and experience. The first page of the notice gives the address as "Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, Nainwal Mode, Gurugram-122 052 (Haryana)". The application form is headed with the email ID [email protected] ; the notice does not say that applications are to be sent by email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are shortlisted by a duly constituted Screening Committee, and its decision is final. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Merely fulfilling the minimum qualification and experience does not give any right to be called for interview. The notice does not mention an interview date or venue. The Centre will not entertain correspondence about shortlisting and will not attend interim enquiries.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in NBRC Project Associate-I recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 (one) position of Project Associate-I (Project) in the HFSP funded project.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for NBRC Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The hard copy application should reach the NBRC office by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for NBRC Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Natural Sciences or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc, or a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine, from a recognized University or equivalent, with minimum 60% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for NBRC Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, counted as on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for NBRC Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: It is ₹ 31,000 + HRA per month for those who have qualified a national level examination such as CSIR-UGC-NET, GATE, JGEEBILS or DBT / ICMR-JRF, and ₹ 25,000 + HRA per month for others.

faq.question: Q6. Are HRA or other allowances paid on top of the NBRC fellowship?
faq.answer: HRA is paid in addition to the fellowship, as per NBRC rules. The notice states that no other allowances are applicable.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 200, payable by Demand Draft in favor of 'Director, NBRC, Manesar' or online / via UPI to the 'National Brain Research Centre' account.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for NBRC Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Send the filled application form with CV and self-attested certificates in an envelope marked "Application for Project Associate-I (Project)" to The Administrative Officer (Academics), National Brain Research Centre, NH-8, Manesar-122052, Distt Gurugram, Haryana.

faq.question: Q9. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Applications are shortlisted by the Screening Committee and only shortlisted candidates are called for an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is the NBRC Project Associate-I post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a project post for one year, renewable for one more year on successful performance review, and it is co-terminus with the project.
